events.name: Hot Chick Ice Cream Scene
events.description: At a mall ice cream counter you take a slow sip of a whipped-cream drink, hold up a dab of cream on your fingertip and ask 'how much do I owe you?'; the smitten server says 'it's on the house', and you walk off with one look back.

events.name: Huell Money
events.description: In a storage unit stacked with cash, one of you falls back onto the pile of money and lies there in bliss; the other argues, gives up and lies down too, hands folded, side by side on the bills.

events.name: Island Boy
events.description: At a small garden pool, one of you sits on the stone edge with socks in the water while the other stands waist-deep in a black leather jacket and sings the island boy hook to the camera.

events.name: Not Like Us Halftime
events.description: You take the mic at the centre of the 2025 halftime show stage for Not Like Us: blue varsity jacket, four dancers in white posed around you, the dark stadium lit by phone lights.

events.name: Office Parkour
events.description: You burst into the office, dive head-first onto the couch, land upside down, then sit up and shout "Parkour!" at the camera while your colleagues climb over the reception counter and the desks.

events.name: Waist Heart
events.description: You tap your chin, flex one arm, wag two fingers, then rest a curved hand on your waist so it makes a heart, and hold it with a smile.

events.name: Zoolander Stare
events.description: On a red carpet lined with photographers you turn over your shoulder with a big smile, spot your rival arriving in a blue fur coat, and the smile drops into a long, narrow-eyed stare. Your rival stares right back.
